title: Citizen Services CRM and Case Analytics
issuer: Ministry of Interior, Republic of Valdemar
raw_text: The Ministry of Interior, Republic of Valdemar, receives 240,000 citizen service cases yearly through 30 municipal offices, tracked in a spreadsheet per office with no national view. We require a CRM Analytics implementation on an existing Salesforce platform to give central oversight of case volume, resolution time, and backlog by office, feeding a monthly reporting pack to the minister. Offices must be able to continue working offline during connectivity loss and reconcile on reconnect. Data residency for citizen records is restricted to infrastructure we operate, and the solution must not replicate that data into any external analytics service.
requirements: CRM Analytics on the existing Salesforce platform for central case oversight
Monthly reporting pack covering volume, resolution time, and backlog by office
Offline working capability in 30 municipal offices with reconciliation on reconnect
Citizen record data residency restricted to ministry-operated infrastructure
